title: Skills and Agent SDKs — Anthropic Skills, AGENTS.md, OpenAI Apps SDK

questions.question: What does parse_frontmatter return for a well-formed SKILL.md?
options: Only the first line of the file
A compiled Python module
a frontmatter dict plus the body
An empty dictionary whenever the body is nonempty
questions.explanation: The parser requires --- delimiters, extracts colon-separated frontmatter fields, and returns the remaining body separately.

questions.question: What does discover_skills find in the lesson fixtures?
options: One skill with an unnamed directory
Every file under /tmp including style-guide.md
No skills because discovery requires network access
two named skills
questions.explanation: The fixture root contains two valid SKILL.md directories; discovery sorts them and indexes the parsed names.

questions.question: Why does invoking release-notes-writer read style-guide.md?
options: The body reference triggers a style-guide read
The file is always loaded for every skill
The MCP server sends it as an OAuth token
The parser mistakes the filename for the skill name
questions.explanation: agent_run loads the skill body first, notices its style-guide.md reference, then reads that subresource before composing the final prompt.

questions.question: What does read_subresource return when a requested file is absent?
options: None, which crashes the agent
(no such subresource: filename)
A new empty file
The full SKILL.md body
questions.explanation: The helper returns a visible diagnostic string for a missing subresource rather than raising or silently inventing content.

questions.question: How do the three instruction layers differ in the demo?
options: They are three copies of the same prompt
MCP supplies static prose while AGENTS.md executes tools
AGENTS=context, SKILL=workflow, MCP=tools
SKILL.md is used only for authentication
questions.explanation: The demo prints the hierarchy: repository guidance from AGENTS, task-specific skill instructions, and tool capabilities from MCP.

questions.question: What does load_skill require before returning a Skill object?
options: Only a directory name
A network URL and an OAuth token
A compiled SDK package
valid SKILL.md with name
questions.explanation: load_skill checks that SKILL.md exists and its frontmatter contains name; malformed or unnamed files are not loaded as skills.
